statement: AMD Instinct with ROCm and Cisco fabric is now shipping as a full production alternative stack for training and inference GPU-as-a-service.
why: A working non-NVIDIA training and inference stack in commercial service widens the pool of usable accelerator supply for buyers.

impact.mechanism: Proven alternative silicon plus open software gives buyers a second qualified source, easing overall accelerator scarcity while pressuring incumbent share.

evidence.excerpt: current deployment of AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs is now live and serving HUMAIN customers in Saudi Arabia and beyond

confidence.basis: Primary vendor release describing systems already in production service.
